decision_rationale: Primary model paper on genomic language models, but the evidence only supports DNA/genomic sequence modeling and phenotypic prediction. No natural-language text component or text-bio bridge is described, and the abstract does not state a generative mechanism.
evidence_snippet: "genomic language modeling (gLM)"; "trained five byte-pair encoding tokenizers and pretrained 52 gLMs"; "outperforms... in 13 of 19 benchmarking phenotypic predictions"; "classification heads"; "DNA sequences can be conceptualized as a complex language"
